goal: Remove the redundant persistent acquired-skill list and keep a compact, repeat-friendly result experience inside the summon presentation.
acceptance_criteria: The persistent vertical acquired-skill list is removed from the skill-gacha screen.
One-draw and ten-draw results remain visible in the summon presentation, with ten draws using the compact five-by-two grid on narrow screens.
After the reveal completes, tapping or keyboard-activating one card shows only that card's type, power, effect, and acquisition count.
Repeat draw, skill-change routing, close, quick mode, skip, reduced motion, and pre-presentation reward saving remain available.
Pools, COST weights, prices, guarantee, IDs, saves, and inventory semantics remain unchanged.

phases.name: goal_and_boundary
phases.deliverable: Limited the follow-up to redundant result UI while preserving all draw and persistence contracts.

phases.name: compact_result_implementation
phases.deliverable: Removed the persistent list and added a compact result grid with tap-only single-card detail.

phases.name: integration_qa_and_safe_merge
phases.deliverable: Run dedicated and full checks, open a pull request, observe CI, and merge only if current and conflict-free.

phases.name: pages_and_published_verification
phases.deliverable: Observe main CI and Pages, then verify published HTML, JavaScript, CSS, and notice contracts.

phases.name: completion_and_stop
phases.deliverable: Record final evidence, restore the waiting state, and stop without selecting another item.

stop_condition: After Phase 63 is recorded and published, do not select or start another backlog item.
